name: WorkBright
description_en:
WorkBright is an HR compliance and employee-document platform centered on US I-9, E-Verify and hiring paperwork. It also offers managed employment forms, integrations and WorkBright+, a separately positioned full-service I-9 management offering using AI and compliance specialists.

It is best evaluated as a specialized onboarding and compliance layer alongside an existing HR stack. The ordinary software starting price and the per-record WorkBright+ service have different commercial conditions; indemnification covers eligible managed errors with explicit exclusions.
description_zh:
WorkBright 是围绕美国 I-9、E-Verify 及招聘文书的 HR 合规与员工文档平台，也提供托管雇佣表单、集成，以及结合 AI 和合规专家的独立 WorkBright+ 全托管 I-9 服务。

它适合作为既有 HR 系统旁的专业入职及合规层评估。普通软件起价与 WorkBright+ 按记录收费有不同商务条件，赔偿仅覆盖符合条件的托管错误，并有明确排除项。

core_features.explanation_en: Manage custom forms, acknowledgments, certifications and tax documents, with vendor-managed form builds and updates.
core_features.explanation_zh: 管理自定义表单、确认、证书及税务文档，由供应商托管构建和更新。

core_features.explanation_en: The forms page describes autofill, reminders, signatures, SSO/MFA, open API and Zapier data flows.
core_features.explanation_zh: 表单页描述自动填充、提醒、签名、SSO/MFA、开放 API 及 Zapier 数据流。

core_features.name_zh: WorkBright+ 托管 I-9 生命周期
core_features.explanation_en: The managed service describes Section 2, E-Verify/TNC cases, reverifications, corrections, exceptions and audit records.
core_features.explanation_zh: 托管服务描述第二部分、E-Verify/TNC 案件、重新核验、更正、异常及审计记录。

pricing.summary_en: Ordinary plans advertised from $192/month; WorkBright+ $25/I-9 with table stating $25,000 annual minimum. 60-day refund trial advertised, exact terms and modules require quote.
pricing.summary_zh: 普通方案宣传每月 192 美元起；WorkBright+ 每份 I-9 25 美元，对照表列年度最低 25,000 美元。宣传 60 天退款试用，具体条款及模块需报价。

Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Define whether you need software or managed I-9s
sections.title_zh: 先确定软件还是托管 I-9 服务
sections.en: The current homepage emphasizes I-9, E-Verify and employment documentation rather than a complete payroll or performance suite. WorkBright+ is described as handling I-9 initiation, completion, E-Verify cases and reverifications, while its employment-form product covers other employee documents. A buyer already using an HRIS should identify the authoritative employee record and the handoff into WorkBright. An ordinary software subscription should not be assumed to include every managed-service task. Interface animations showing authorized workers are product illustrations, not verified employment decisions or executed checks.
sections.zh: 当前首页重点为 I-9、E-Verify 和雇佣文档，并非完整工资或绩效套件。WorkBright+ 描述从启动、完成 I-9 到 E-Verify 案件及重新核验的托管，雇佣表单产品则覆盖其他文档。已有 HRIS 的买家应明确员工主档及进入 WorkBright 的衔接。普通软件订阅不能推定包含全部托管任务，界面动画中的授权人员也是产品示例，不是已验证的雇佣决定或已执行检查。

sections.en: The employment-form page describes managed state and federal forms, custom acknowledgments and certifications, reminders, autofill and reportable fields. WorkBright says it handles custom-form migration, builds and edits, with unlimited documents and updates. For an illustrative new hire, assign the correct forms by role or location, collect missing information, correct a field and confirm the receiving HR system sees the intended data. API and Zapier support establish integration routes, not proof that every destination, retry or duplicate-prevention scenario works. SSO and MFA are listed but were not configured or tested.
sections.zh: 雇佣表单页描述托管州和联邦表单、自定义确认及证书、提醒、自动填充和可报告字段。WorkBright 称负责自定义表单迁移、构建及编辑，文档和更新不限数量。以新员工为例，可按岗位或地点分配表单、补全资料、更正字段，再确认接收 HR 系统获得预期数据。API 和 Zapier 表明有集成路径，不证明每个目标、重试或去重场景均可用。SSO 及 MFA 已列出，但未配置测试。

sections.title_en: Follow exceptions as well as successful cases
sections.title_zh: 同时跟踪异常与成功案件
sections.en: WorkBright+ describes AI identifying issues and running workflows, with human specialists handling complex exceptions. It covers Section 2 completion, E-Verify cases and tentative nonconfirmations, document corrections and reverification deadlines. An evaluation should inspect an incomplete document, a TNC and a case escalated back to the employer, not only a successful submission. These are suggested acceptance cases, not legal instructions or executed tests. Employers retain employment decisions, and service eligibility and deadlines should be confirmed under the applicable agreement.
sections.zh: WorkBright+ 描述 AI 识别问题、执行流程，由人工专家处理复杂异常，范围包括第二部分、E-Verify 及暂时不确认案件、文档更正和重新核验期限。评估应查看文档不完整、TNC 和退回雇主升级处理的案例，不能只看成功提交。这些是验收建议，不是法律操作指导或实测。雇佣决定仍由雇主负责，服务资格及期限需以适用协议确认。

sections.title_en: Distinguish the monthly plan from the annual minimum
sections.title_zh: 区分月度方案与年度最低金额
sections.en: The demo page advertises plans from $192 per month and a 60-day risk-free trial with a full-refund statement. It does not establish which exact modules that starting plan includes. WorkBright+ separately advertises $25 per I-9, and its comparison table states a minimum $25,000 annual cost. A small employer therefore cannot assume that processing ten forms costs only $250 annually under that service. The calculator’s time, error and exposure figures are expressly illustrative, not observed results. Ask for the applicable volume, minimum, renewals, integrations and refund conditions; neither offer establishes a sustained free plan.
sections.zh: 演示页宣传方案每月 192 美元起，并有 60 天无风险试用及全额退款说法，但未确立该起价具体包含哪些模块。WorkBright+ 单独宣传每份 I-9 25 美元，其对照表注明最低年度成本 25,000 美元。因此小雇主不能假定处理十份表单全年只花 250 美元。计算器的工时、错误和风险金额明确属于估算，不是实测。应询问适用数量、最低金额、续订、集成和退款条件；两种优惠均不是长期免费套餐。

sections.en: The policy covers eligible fines from I-9 processing errors managed through WorkBright+, specialized audit support and selected legal and retention costs. It excludes migrated historical I-9s not originally completed through WorkBright and escalated cases the service cannot resolve within the required timeframe; employment decisions remain the employer’s responsibility. Therefore “$0 audit exposure” in a calculator is not a universal risk guarantee. WorkBright is relevant to US hiring-document operations, especially repeat or distributed onboarding, but not a substitute for country-specific payroll or legal judgment. Contract eligibility, retention, export completeness, integration failures and hosting remain unverified. No I-9, E-Verify case, account or audit was executed.
sections.zh: 政策覆盖由 WorkBright+ 托管的 I-9 处理错误所导致的合资格罚款、专业审计支持及部分法律和记录保留成本；排除并非原先通过 WorkBright 完成的历史迁入 I-9，以及服务在规定时限内无法解决而升级的案件，雇佣决定仍由雇主负责。因此计算器的“零审计风险金额”不能当成普遍零风险保证。WorkBright 值得用于美国招聘文档，尤其重复或分散入职评估，但不能替代各国工资或法律判断。合同资格、保留、完整导出、集成失败和托管仍未核实，未执行 I-9、E-Verify、账户或审计。
